plan: Fire Lord Azula attacks every turn from turn 4 (haste from Swiftfoot Boots, Frostcliff Siege, Hidden Footblade or Expedite; hexproof equipment, free redirects and five cheap counters behind her); while she attacks she copies every instant and flash spell, so draw, removal, tutors and Torrential Gearhulk are two-for-ones, Black Market Connections and Archmage Emeritus keep the hand and the Treasures full, and the win comes in one protected combat: a three-card loop with her (Narset's Reversal with Turnabout, Frantic Search or Storm-Kiln Artist; Snap with Dualcaster Mage) makes unbounded mana or casts, which a multikicked, copied Comet Storm or Thermo-Alchemist pings turn into lethal damage to each opponent.
backup: Without a loop the same window cards win fairly: Turnabout, Snap, Frantic Search, Big Score, Storm-Kiln Artist and banked mana (Horizon Stone, Ozai, Electro, Treasures) fuel a copied Comet Storm or Electrodominance (2X to each opponent), with Torrential Gearhulk recasting Turnabout, Frantic Search or the draw spells for free; with Azula answered, Godo fetches Helm of the Host for unlimited combats, Ozai attacks with haste, and Comet Storm is cast uncopied with the banked mana.

Azula three-card loops.vs_three: While Azula attacks (she need not connect): Narset's Reversal with Turnabout (unbounded mana from 4 lands), with Storm-Kiln Artist (unbounded Treasures) or with Frantic Search (about +1 mana and four new cards a cycle: library-bound, it digs for Turnabout or Comet Storm and is not a kill alone); or Snap with Dualcaster Mage (unbounded untapped lands, every opposing creature bounced). With unbounded mana the Reversal also returns any instant to hand each cycle, so Comet Storm, Electrodominance or any draw spell repeats: Comet Storm kicked twice and copied is X lethal to all three at once; Thermo-Alchemist untaps on every cast and pings EACH opponent. Mystical Teachings (copied in combat: two pieces) and Solve the Equation find every instant piece; Shred Memory transmutes for a mana-value-2 card (the Reversal, Snap, Comet Storm, Electrodominance). Never loop Frantic Search with Archmage Emeritus out (mandatory draws).

Copied X burn to each opponent.vs_three: Comet Storm kicked twice names all three opponents; Azula copies it, 2X to each. Turnabout copied in combat untaps every land twice; Torrential Gearhulk cast in the window is copied and its two triggers recast Turnabout and Frantic Search (or two draw spells) for free, each copied again; Horizon Stone, Ozai, Electro and Black Market Connections' Treasures bring mana from earlier turns: X of 8 to 12 by turn 7 to 8, twice if needed. Without Azula it is cast once with banked mana. Electrodominance copied adds 2X to one or two players and casts two free spells (Gearhulk, Aether Gale, Godo). No combat damage needed.

Azula, Helm and Godo in combat.vs_three: Godo puts Helm of the Host onto the battlefield and, with Helm equipped, every combat makes a new hasty Godo token whose first attack adds another combat: unlimited combats WITHOUT Azula (late two-card line, the route that survives her removal), spread over the opponents who lack two solid blockers, and an arbitrarily large army for the next turn; Aether Gale or Turnabout removes the blockers first. Helm on Azula makes a hasty Azula every combat (each spell copied twice). Ozai hits another player with 7 trample, indestructible and flying with six floating mana. Frostcliff Siege gives the team haste and trample; Rogue's Passage makes one attacker unblockable.
